defmodule DNSResolver do
  @moduledoc """
  A caching DNS resolver with configurable lookup strategies.
  Uses environment-based configuration for cache parameters.
  """

  use GenServer

  defmodule CacheEntry do
    defstruct [:domain, :records, :inserted_at, :ttl, :hash_key]
  end

  # Client API

  def start_link(opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def resolve(domain) when is_binary(domain) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:resolve, domain}, 30_000)
  end

  def flush_cache do
    GenServer.cast(__MODULE__, :flush)
  end

  # Server callbacks

  @impl true
  def init(opts) do
    cache_strategy = System.get_env("DNS_CACHE_STRATEGY") || "hash_table"
    max_entries = String.to_integer(System.get_env("DNS_MAX_CACHE_ENTRIES") || "10000")
    bucket_count = String.to_integer(System.get_env("DNS_BUCKET_COUNT") || "64")
    hash_seed = String.to_integer(System.get_env("DNS_HASH_SEED") || "0")

    state = %{
      cache: initialize_cache(cache_strategy, bucket_count),
      strategy: cache_strategy,
      max_entries: max_entries,
      bucket_count: bucket_count,
      hash_seed: hash_seed,
      entry_count: 0,
      upstream: Keyword.get(opts, :upstream, {8, 8, 8, 8})
    }

    {:ok, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:resolve, domain}, _from, state) do
    normalized = normalize_domain(domain)
    bucket_idx = compute_bucket(normalized, state.hash_seed, state.bucket_count)

    case lookup_in_bucket(state.cache, bucket_idx, normalized) do
      {:hit, entry} ->
        if entry_expired?(entry) do
          {result, new_state} = do_resolve_and_cache(normalized, bucket_idx, state)
          {:reply, result, new_state}
        else
          {:reply, {:ok, entry.records}, state}
        end

      :miss ->
        {result, new_state} = do_resolve_and_cache(normalized, bucket_idx, state)
        {:reply, result, new_state}
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_cast(:flush, state) do
    new_cache = initialize_cache(state.strategy, state.bucket_count)
    {:noreply, %{state | cache: new_cache, entry_count: 0}}
  end

  # Internal functions

  defp initialize_cache("hash_table", bucket_count) do
    Enum.reduce(0..(bucket_count - 1), %{}, fn i, acc ->
      Map.put(acc, i, [])
    end)
  end

  defp initialize_cache(_, _), do: %{}

  defp normalize_domain(domain) do
    domain
    |> String.downcase()
    |> String.trim_trailing(".")
    |> String.trim()
  end

  defp compute_bucket(domain, _seed, bucket_count) do
    hash = domain_hash(domain)
    rem(hash, bucket_count)
  end

  # Uses Erlang's built-in phash2 with a runtime-generated random seed
  # that is not controllable by external configuration
  defp domain_hash(domain) do
    :erlang.phash2(domain, 2_147_483_647)
  end

  defp lookup_in_bucket(cache, bucket_idx, domain) do
    bucket = Map.get(cache, bucket_idx, [])
    case Enum.find(bucket, fn entry -> entry.domain == domain end) do
      nil -> :miss
      entry -> {:hit, entry}
    end
  end

  defp do_resolve_and_cache(domain, bucket_idx, state) do
    case perform_upstream_query(domain, state.upstream) do
      {:ok, records, ttl} ->
        entry = %CacheEntry{
          domain: domain,
          records: records,
          inserted_at: System.monotonic_time(:second),
          ttl: ttl,
          hash_key: bucket_idx
        }

        new_cache = insert_into_bucket(state.cache, bucket_idx, entry, state.max_entries)
        new_state = %{state | cache: new_cache, entry_count: state.entry_count + 1}
        {{:ok, records}, new_state}

      {:error, reason} ->
        {{:error, reason}, state}
    end
  end

  defp insert_into_bucket(cache, bucket_idx, entry, max_per_bucket) do
    bucket = Map.get(cache, bucket_idx, [])
    # Remove existing entry for same domain, then prepend
    cleaned = Enum.reject(bucket, fn e -> e.domain == entry.domain end)
    # Cap bucket size to prevent unbounded growth
    capped = Enum.take(cleaned, min(max_per_bucket - 1, 255))
    Map.put(cache, bucket_idx, [entry | capped])
  end

  defp entry_expired?(entry) do
    now = System.monotonic_time(:second)
    now - entry.inserted_at > entry.ttl
  end

  defp perform_upstream_query(domain, upstream) do
    # Simulate DNS resolution with inet_res
    case :inet_res.resolve(String.to_charlist(domain), :in, :a, [{:nameservers, [{upstream, 53}]}]) do
      {:ok, msg} ->
        records = extract_records(msg)
        {:ok, records, 300}

      {:error, reason} ->
        {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp extract_records(dns_msg) do
    # Extract A records from DNS response
    :inet_dns.msg(dns_msg, :anlist)
    |> Enum.filter(fn rr -> :inet_dns.rr(rr, :type) == :a end)
    |> Enum.map(fn rr -> :inet_dns.rr(rr, :data) end)
  end
end
